ctx.x: Every time we would play, we'd have a hundred requests for Dr. Jazz. And unfortunately, the lead man didn't know Dr. Jazz. I know it now, though. And if ever, oh, we got a letter. They just sent us a letter. They want us to go to Rome next year for a similar DLC. And you can bet if we go to Rome, I will play Dr. Jazz until I'm blue in the face. I know it now.

I have to give you that guy's name over there that I know. His name is Claude Cock. K-O-C-H. He sounds like a Frenchman and a German, but he's in Rome last I heard from him. He was over here in Biloxi training for the Italian Air Force. And he bought a lot of my records. He wanted to get old, you know, kid shots records and stuff like that. I was starving, I think, at the time. I told him, $30 worth of records.

Well, we got this letter. I mean, they want us to go to Rome now. Well, it's going to be a similar deal. And we also supposed to go to Washington, D.C., February 27th for the, they got this Congressional Carnival Ball over there. And we supposed to play for that. So we keep an active just enough to, you know, keep in shape, you know. Do you rehearse? Huh? Do you rehearse? Well, I'll tell you, there's rumor that we're getting ready to make a record for the Louisiana Historical Society. Now, this, this fella made a…
